description: Patch-level automerge is deliberately NOT extended here, and the reason is not risk. Wetty keeps no state at all - no database, no volumes, no migrations, and the role runs it read-only with nothing but a tmpfs - so a patch bump that broke anything would break it at startup, where the Molecule scenario runs a real command through the terminal over a real SSH leg at the pinned version and would catch it. On upgrade risk alone this role would qualify.

It is declined because there is nothing at the patch level for Renovate to see. ghcr.io/butlerx/wetty last published a versioned image tag on 2026-05-26: `3.0.0`, `3.0` and `3`. Upstream has cut v3.0.1, v3.0.2, v3.0.3, v3.0.4, v3.1.0 and v3.2.0 as GitHub releases since, and not one of them has a container image tag - checked against the full ghcr.io tag listing (79 tags, a single page) and against Docker Hub's wettyoss/wetty (80 tags); every build since 3.0.0 landed only as `main`, `latest` and `sha-<short>`. Upstream's Docker Publish job runs from the branch ref after semantic-release has run, so docker/metadata-action's `type=semver` patterns match nothing and only the branch, latest and sha tags get pushed.

Turning patch-automerge on against that would not automerge patches; it would sit inert until upstream's tagging is fixed, and then unattended-merge whatever backlog of releases had accumulated in the meantime in a single `patch` step. That is the opposite of what the preset is for. Revisit when ghcr.io/butlerx/wetty carries a versioned tag newer than 3.0.0.

`versioning=semver` on the annotation in defaults/main.yml is load-bearing and must stay. The registry carries the floating `3`, `3.0`, `2`, `2.1`, `2.4` and `2.5` tags alongside the real ones, plus `main`, `latest`, one stray `dependabot-npm_and_yarn-vm2-3.9.7` and fifty-odd `sha-<short>` tags. Strict semver rejects every one of those - `3` and `3.0` are not semver versions - and leaves only real `X.Y.Z` releases. Without it Renovate would follow the floating major, which is a silent auto-upgrade channel with nothing reviewable and no fixed tag to pin.
